purpose: Verify the generic APT CLI supplier probe can turn pinned package metadata into executable/help evidence without QR-specific probe code.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python canonical/runtime/apt_cli_probe.py qrencode 4.1.1-1build2 613c5a22316489ec6a9ce5d59190293df15dd4612b55432dde04c62f7c1a0e25 canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/ASTRA-APT-CLI-GENERIC-PROBE-QR-001__RESULT.json
python - <<'PY'
import json
x=json.load(open('canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/ASTRA-APT-CLI-GENERIC-PROBE-QR-001__RESULT.json'))
assert any(e['executable'].endswith('/qrencode') for e in x['executables'])
assert any(any(a['text'] for a in e['help_attempts']) for e in x['executables'])
print('GENERIC_APT_CLI_PROBE_COMPLETE')
PY
